declined.specs: Three open roadmap items, none longer than one row. A tasks/ directory would hold nothing today, and an empty one invites entries that are really change notes. Re-open when a roadmap row grows past three paragraphs.

notes.skills: Project skills are in .claude/skills/, committed via the !.claude/skills/ negation in .gitignore. This was a deviation when it was written, because the skill-placement block still named a repo-root skills/ source and a generation step that exists nowhere; the block was corrected on 2026-08-06 and this is now the standard reading. See the standards repo's DECISIONS.md under that date.
notes.check-docs: tools/check-docs.sh is copied unchanged from the standards repo and reads this file for the module selection. It takes no arguments and checks the document contract only; the language sweep and tools/check-docs.allow were removed from this project on 2026-11-10. It runs from the verify skill; no pre-commit hook and no CI job yet.
